title: Warm Roasted Japanese Russet Potato Shio Ramen
description: A hearty and comforting Japanese dish featuring roasted russet potatoes in a rich shio ramen broth, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This low-carb-friendly recipe is a creative twist on traditional ramen.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
Toss the cubed potatoes with 1 tablespoon of pork or chicken fat and season with salt to taste.
Roast the potatoes in the oven for 20 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly browned.
In a large pot, combine the chicken broth, shio koji, soy sauce, and sake, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the broth for 10 minutes, or until it has reduced slightly and the flavors have melded together.
Add the roasted potatoes to the broth and cook for an additional 2 minutes, or until they are heated through.
Stir in the remaining 1 tablespoon of pork or chicken fat and season the broth with salt to taste.
Ladle the broth and potatoes into bowls and garnish with green onions and sesame seeds.
Serve the ramen hot, with additional soy sauce and sake on the side if desired.
